disambiguation: It functions as a comprehensive command center, handling search, workflow management, and file actions, not just a simple search bar.
extras: Pro version costs $8 one-time; the plugin is local-first and does not send data externally.
intentEvidence: A Raycast-style command center for Obsidian: find notes fast, reopen recurring work instantly, and act on results — all without leaving the keyboard.
problem: Users need a fast, keyboard-driven way to locate specific notes, recall past projects, and perform immediate actions without navigating menus.
summary: A keyboard-first command center that provides fuzzy search, workflow management, and immediate actions for finding and manipulating notes and vault objects.
